claims: The Pittsburgh Penguins lost 3-2 to the Philadelphia Flyers in Game 1 of the NHL Playoffs on Saturday, April 18, 2026.
The Philadelphia Flyers took a 1-0 series lead after Game 1.
Game 1 was at PPG Paints Arena, Pittsburgh.
Philadelphia took a 2-1 lead in the second period of Game 1.
Post-game comments were made by Erik Karlsson, Stuart Skinner, Sidney Crosby, and coach Dan Muse.
Game 2 is scheduled for Monday, April 20, at 4:00 PM ET at PPG Paints Arena.
Game 3 is scheduled for Wednesday, April 22 @ Philadelphia Flyers, 4:00 PM ET.
